title: Rabbi Yitzchak bar Chama
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman cites Midrash Tehillim 2:6 for his saying that all the Holy One’s activities are in holiness. Hyman traces the teaching to Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:1, which has a different reading. Pesikta Rabbati, “Anokhi Menachemchem,” section 3, has Rabbi Yitzchak the Priest bar Chama reporting Rabbi Chilkiyahu.

notes.text: The named Pesikta section is followed by ס״ג, read as section 3, not an isolated number 63. The source does not specify whether the different Jerusalem Talmud reading affects the wording or attribution.
The consulted Midrash Tehillim attributes the holiness teaching to Rabbi Yitzchak without the patronymic bar Chama.
